name: single
query: * | select compare(c, 300) as r from (select count(*) as c from log)

name: multi
query: * | select compare(c, 300, 600) as r from (select count(*) as c from log)

name: window
query: * | select compare(c, 300) as r from (select count(*) as c from log)

name: grouped
query: * | select level, compare(c, 300) as r from (select level, count(*) as c from log group by level) group by level order by level

name: search
query: level: ERROR | select compare(c, 300) as r from (select count(*) as c from log)

name: avg
query: * | select compare(a, 300) as r from (select avg(latency_ms) as a from log)

name: unnest
query: * | select r[1] as now, r[2] as before, r[3] as ratio from (select compare(c, 300) as r from (select count(*) as c from log))

name: no-history
query: * | select compare(c, 300) as r from (select count(*) as c from log)
